images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of RISEBench++.We present illustrative example questions from each of the six major reasoning categories: temporal, causal, spatial, logical, counterfactual, and hybrid reasoning, each demanding profound image understanding and reasoning capabilities.

Figure 2:Task distribution and word clouds of RISEBench++.RISEBench++ comprises 1,000 tasks organized into a three-level taxonomy of six reasoning dimensions:Temporal(200),Causal(200),Spatial(200),Logical(200),Counterfactual(100), andHybrid(100) Reasoning.

Figure 3:Evaluation metrics and pipeline of RISEBench++.RISEBench++ evaluates generated images acrossInstruction Reasoning,Appearance Consistency, andVisual Plausibility. Gemini-3-Flash evaluates the first two using dimension-specific prompts, while Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite evaluates the third.

Figure 4:Overview of RISE-Agent.RISE-Agent follows a closed-loop workflow of reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, bridging target-state inference with precise visual realization.

Figure 5:Comparison across three evaluation dimensions on RISEBench++ (EN).Nano Banana Pro achieves the highest instruction reasoning score, while GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst leads in appearance consistency and visual plausibility.
Figure 7:Examples of several different models’ outputs on RISEBench++.The analyzed models demonstrate distinct characteristics in their responses.
